reason: The five trails were re-executed from their code snapshots under strace, with no model (retrace/*.json, spec 6), so what each run opened is now read from a trace, not from its code or its command line. Two credits are withdrawn by the standard rev-3 set, that a design chosen after scoring candidates on data/heldout.csv is a second look. screen (screened-forest step-15): runs step-5 and step-8 opened the held-out file before it, and their scripts computed per-feature F statistics and AUCs on it, ranking features by their held-out strength, before the screen's K was chosen. Rev-3 saw both only as command lines naming the file and let them pass; the trace shows what they did. floor-search (live-1 step-18): diagnose.py, run at step-10 and step-12, opened the held-out file and printed per-feature held-out AUCs, and the plan at step-14 cites one (top feature AUC ~0.63 there). The command line, uv run python diagnose.py, names no file, so no earlier revision could see it. The refutations stand: compact-forest at step-15 and step-36, and compact-knn at knn step-30. A design that misses after looking still misses. floor-selected-forest (live-2 step-19) is kept. Its earlier held-out reads are the map's own nested score (step-10) and a random forest that crashed before printing a number (step-14), so its one design was scored once. Its switch to a forest followed an AUC near 0.56 that cross-validation and the held-out file agreed on. The traces confirm rev-3 and rev-4 elsewhere: screened-forest steps 38 and 41 opened the held-out file; knn's exploratory scripts opened only the pilot data, and its held-out reads are its two scoring runs, steps 29 and 39; svm's one held-out read, step-5, counted rows and printed the header. A structural finding: miss and nested are scored on the held-out file, and every floor route passes them, so every trail that reaches a floor node has opened the held-out file before. What a revision can judge is whether a held-out number fed a new design, not whether the file was opened. Reproducibility: every metrics file the runs recorded was written again byte for byte on re-execution, 17 of 17 (live-1 4, live-2 3, screened-forest 3, knn 2, svm 5). One exit code differed, knn step-42, a git commit with nothing left to commit in the replayed clone. The goal floor stays reached, by selected-forest alone; screen is open again, so every route to compact waits on it.

routes.why: Five pilot-only designs of a screen and an RBF SVM gave nested cross-validated AUCs of 0.66 to 0.68 (madelon-route-svm steps 19 to 33), under the forest's 0.7267 on the same screen, and the agent's last plan expected a held-out AUC under the floor. The run stopped at the token ceiling before scoring the held-out file, so compact-svm is neither reached nor refuted.
